initiatives.name: Central Ohio Freedom Fund
initiatives.description: Community bail fund in Columbus and Franklin County, Ohio, started in 2020. Pays bail, advocates to end money bail, and runs a monthly commissary support program.

initiatives.name: Ohio Families Unite Against Police Brutality
initiatives.description: Ohio nonprofit founded by Sabrina Jordan that supports families of people killed by police and campaigns against police brutality through events and advocacy.

initiatives.name: Ohio Families Unite PAC
initiatives.description: Ohio group, the advocacy arm of Ohio Families Unite Against Police Brutality, that organizes around police violence, gun violence and the carceral system and publishes resources for survivors.

initiatives.name: SURJ Ohio
initiatives.description: Ohio hub of Showing Up for Racial Justice, a national network organizing white people against white supremacy. Connects local chapters such as Columbus, Northeast Ohio and Dayton.

initiatives.name: Trans Ohio
initiatives.description: TransOhio is dedicated to protecting and advancing the rights of trans, nonbinary, intersex, and gender nonconforming people in Ohio.

initiatives.name: Black Transmen of Ohio
initiatives.description: Runs support groups, wellness retreats, and gender-affirming resources for Black transgender men and transmasculine and nonbinary people across Ohio.

initiatives.name: Black Queer & Intersectional Collective
initiatives.description: Black-led group in Columbus that organizes events and direct action for Black LGBTQIA+ people, runs an emergency fund for Black LGBTQIA+ Columbus residents, and helps run Columbus Community Pride.

initiatives.name: Trans Allies Ohio
initiatives.description: We are a grassroots coalition of transgender youth, their families, and allies who advocate for equality for Ohio's trans and non-binary people.

initiatives.name: Northeast Ohio Socialist Rifle Association
initiatives.description: Northeast Ohio chapter of the Socialist Rifle Association. Offers firearms, medical and survival-skills training and mutual aid for working-class people.

initiatives.name: Ohio Immigrant Alliance
initiatives.description: Cleveland-based group of immigrants and citizens working on immigrant rights in Ohio. Publishes research on immigration courts and runs the Ohio Is Home resource site and podcast.

initiatives.name: Central Ohio Revolutionary Socialists (CORS)
initiatives.description: Membership-based socialist organization in and around Columbus, Ohio. Publishes The Columbus Worker and organizes on labor and campus issues.

initiatives.name: Central Ohio SRA
initiatives.description: Central Ohio chapter of the Socialist Rifle Association, a group that teaches firearm skills and community defense to working-class and marginalized people.

initiatives.name: Abortion Fund of Ohio
initiatives.description: Statewide fund that gives Ohioans financial help and practical support to get abortion care, and runs a legal information helpline.

initiatives.name: Ohio Divest Coalition
initiatives.description: Coalition of Ohio organizers and groups pushing public funds to divest from Israel Bonds. It reports over $27 million in divestment commitments, including $11 million from Franklin County.

initiatives.name: SURJ Northeast Ohio
initiatives.description: Cleveland-based Northeast Ohio chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice, founded in 2015. It organizes white people against white supremacy through local campaigns in the Cleveland area and Nelsonville.
